entities.summary: Valentin Egorevich Kuzin was a Soviet ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Championship League with HC Dynamo Moscow. He also played for the Soviet national team at the 1956 Winter Olympics, where he won a gold medal He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1954.
